{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tharak installation''' was an orbital control station located on the continent of [[Tharak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. Situated inside a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]], it survived the [[Great Cleansing]]. It beamed a signal to the [[Deathmoon]] base three times a day which was a "doomsday clock" countdown to launch hundreds of [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|atomic missiles]]. The [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] of the [[Roh tribe]] traveled to the installation every six month to reset the countdown through a ceremonial procedure of pushing buttons and pulling levers, although they had no idea what they were actually doing.
